chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sahl, from his father who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hassan (peace be upon him) about a man who had relations with his wife during the month of Ramadan while he was a traveler. He (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no problem.'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no problem / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: Does sexual intercourse invalidate the fast for a traveler in Ramadan?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies that a traveler’s sexual intercourse during the daytime of Ramadan does not invalidate the fast, distinguishing the ruling from that of the resident. This reflects the Shia juristic principle that the stricter penalty of *Kaffarah* applies primarily to residents, while travelers are exempt from it for this specific act, highlighting the flexibility (*rukhas*) granted in Islamic law for those on journey.
